:= by
  have h1 : i.range = LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra R L p.ker → Function.Exact ⇑i ⇑p :=
    assume h : i.range = LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra R L p.ker,
    begin
      rw h,
      apply LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_submodule,
      intro x,
      rcases mem_LieIdeal_toLieSubalgebra_iff.1 (mem_range_iff.2 x) with ⟨y, eq⟩,
      rw eq at eq,
      exact mem_ker_of_map_eq_zero (p.map_eq_zero (i.map y))
    end
  have h2 : Function.Exact ⇑i ⇑p → i.range = LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra R L p.ker :=
    assume h : Function.Exact ⇑i ⇑p,
    begin
      refine le_antisymm (i.range_subset _) (LieIdeal.toLieSubalgebra_subset _ _),
      { intro x,
        rcases mem_range_iff.1 (h (i.map x)) with ⟨y, eq⟩,
        rw eq,
        exact mem_ker_of_map_eq_zero (p.map (i.map y)) },
      { intro x,
        rcases mem_LieIdeal_toLieSubalgebra_iff.1 (mem_ker_of_map_eq_zero (p.map x)) with ⟨y, eq⟩,
        rw eq,
        exact mem_range_iff.2 (i.map y) }
    end
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
